coverage.label: Breloc -> Masina
coverage.basis: Saved original Volkswagen merchandise screen; not freshly reopened in this six-source review.
coverage.reason: Brand merchandise does not establish a specific functional vehicle relationship. The inferred car-key shortcut remains unsupported for adoption.
coverage.endpoint_mapping: Current personal-car endpoint snapshot matches; a correct endpoint does not validate the inferred association.

coverage.label: Breloc -> Usa
coverage.basis: Saved original key-attachment sources and accepted r3 receipts; no fresh reopen here.
coverage.reason: Key attachment does not directly establish door operation or an independently useful door relation. The hypothetical key-mediated statement remains inference, not a supported direct association.

coverage.label: Breloc -> Cheia de la gat
coverage.basis: Finite screen reports no supporting original evidence.
coverage.reason: The childhood neck-key practice is not established for the frozen accessory. This is a bounded evidence gap, not proof that no such example could ever exist.

coverage.label: Breloc -> fluier
coverage.basis: Fresh original manufacturer text, Description/Features lines479-490.
coverage.reason: Emergency whistles with keyring attachments are documented. That product fact does not establish the current KG endpoint's referee signalling sense; the row's supported annotation can describe the product example only, not a supported canonical sport edge.
coverage.endpoint_mapping: n_v4spo_fluier explicitly describes an instrument used by a referee. Retain unresolved mapping and rejection.

coverage.label: Palnie -> lichid
coverage.basis: Fresh ordinary Velleman funnel text; IKEA S1 remains saved original r3 evidence.
coverage.reason: Liquid refilling supports the pouring function. The endpoint represents the liquid state generally, so the predicate must remain about pouring liquid materials rather than asserting identity, liquid-only exclusivity or a particular household substance.
coverage.qualification: Dry-material uses are source context and remain outside the frozen household liquid-transfer hypothesis.

coverage.label: Palnie -> Ulei
coverage.basis: Fresh original TurnRight Solutions product text, lines48-56.
coverage.reason: The page expressly describes transferring cooking oil to smaller containers and limits bottle fit. The pantry/gastronomie endpoint is appropriate for cooking oil; motor oil and universal container compatibility are not established.

coverage.label: Palnie -> Sampon
coverage.basis: Fresh original seven-page Chemistry Store tutorial PDF, page7/step6.
coverage.reason: The tutorial expressly uses a funnel to fill containers with prepared shampoo/body wash. This supports the optional liquid-shampoo filling caption. It does not establish customary Romanian household use, use with every shampoo, enjoyment or an intuitively salient gameplay association.
coverage.qualification: Tutorial recipe, manufacture, efficacy and formulation instructions are not adopted.

coverage.label: Palnie -> Detergent
coverage.basis: Fresh original Velleman Toolland HFUS1 product description, lines952-960.
coverage.reason: An ordinary nested funnel set explicitly names washing-up liquid and home/kitchen uses. This supports the optional liquid dishwashing-detergent refill caption, not every detergent form or use.
coverage.qualification: Greiner S4 is specialized packaging context, not support for an ordinary utensil. Delphis S5 remains failed access with null evidence and is not counted as verified support.

coverage.label: Paine -> Cutit
coverage.basis: Fresh original Romanian IKEA bread-knife product text, line60.
coverage.reason: The product documents bread cutting. The optional bread-can-be-sliced-with-knife statement fits the broad knife endpoint without claiming every knife is suitable. Current de8204 is outgoing knife-to-bread only; the proposed direct opposite arc is absent.
coverage.qualification: No round, selection, benefit, weight, enum or gameplay approval.

coverage.label: Robinet -> Apa
coverage.basis: Fresh IKEA-hosted instruction PDF AA-2163215-1, Romanian section page0/lines238-247.
coverage.reason: Handle movement controls domestic water release, supporting the narrow flow-control caption. Current de8418 is outgoing water-to-tap only; the proposed direct opposite arc is absent.
coverage.qualification: The document's language sections differ on left/right operation; no handedness, temperature or potability claim is adopted. Hornbach technical/irrigation context remains a nonprimary scope counterexample.
